The full voice cast for Disney's next animated feature film Encanto has been announced alongside the first trailer!  It includes Stephanie Beatriz, Diane Guerrero, Maria Cecilia, Wilmer Valderrama, Adassa, Mauro Castillo, Angie Cepeda, Jessica Darrow, Rhenzy Feliz and Carolina Gaitan.  Find out who is playing what character in this video!
